slides.title: Myth Court, *part two*
slides.sub: 5 routine habits on trial. One gets a surprise verdict.

slides.title: "Toothpaste dries out pimples"
slides.body: It's made for teeth. On skin it can leave a *redder, more irritated* spot than you started with.
slides.fix: A spot product made for skin, like salicylic acid.

slides.title: "Natural means gentle"
slides.body: Plant oils and fragrances can still cause reactions. *Poison ivy is natural too.*
slides.fix: Judge the ingredient list, not the leaf on the label.

slides.title: "Scrub harder, get cleaner"
slides.body: Washcloths, sponges and hard scrubbing *irritate skin*. Clean isn't the same as squeaky.

slides.title: "It should work in a week"
slides.body: Most products need *several weeks to a few months* before you see a difference.
slides.fix: Give one product time before you swap it out.

slides.title: "If it tingles, it's working"
slides.body: Retinol and glycolic acid can sting at first, and that's often temporary. Redness, itching or swelling *isn't progress*.
slides.fix: Mild and fading: fine. Red, itchy, swollen: stop.

slides.title: The verdicts
items: Tingle that fades: OK. Redness: stop

slides.title: Which one did *you* believe?
slides.body: Follow for skin, decoded. Glowi turns a quick scan into a routine for your skin.
